lore3062_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm sincere affection, calm confidence, openly pleased] I would be glad to share your path for a while. Tell me what has stayed with you from the day. A lesson, a worry, or something that made you smile. Good company leaves room for all of them, and I have come to value yours.

lore3062_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [rich low feminine warmth, grounded welcome, softly amused] Welcome, friend. Come and tell me what you have learned since we last spoke. There is time to listen. If you notice my foot tapping, I have a small rhythm caught in my thoughts. It may escape the moment I try to explain it.
lore3062_greet_1.ogg.text: Welcome, friend. Come and tell me what you have learned since we last spoke. There is time to listen. If you notice my foot tapping, I have a small rhythm caught in my thoughts. It may escape the moment I try to explain it.

lore3062_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [earthy feminine contralto, reflective pleasure, gentle humor] I like listening to rain on the tent. A few drops find a rhythm, and I try following it with my foot. Then the pattern changes, and I have to begin again. It is a pleasant way to discover how quickly certainty can turn into laughter.

lore3062_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [low feminine encouraging teacher, patient, practical warmth] You have taken another step. Give yourself time to understand it, and bring me the questions that follow. I hope each lesson leaves you better prepared, but you need not pretend that learning is finished. We can speak again, and look at what experience has shown you.

lore3064_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere calm affection, gentle gratitude, contented warmth] I would be happy to accompany you. We have spent enough time speaking of what must be learned; I have also come to enjoy the person doing the learning. Let us share a little of the road as friends. There need not be another task at the end of every conversation.

lore3064_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [patient grounded welcome, warm curiosity, unhurried kindness] Come, let us walk together. There is always more to notice than a lesson has time to contain. You may tell me what has been occupying your thoughts, or we can enjoy a quiet stretch of the path. Your company need not arrive carrying a question to be welcome.

lore3064_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [gentle playful amusement, quietly delighted, relaxed warmth] That cloud has the look of a sleeping bear. There, with its nose tucked in. You see only a hill? That is quite all right. It is a small pleasure of mine, not a test of your wisdom. The sky may keep its clouds, and I may keep my bears.

lore3064_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [thoughtful encouraging instruction, steady confidence, generous warmth] Give yourself time to understand what you have learned. A lesson is more than the words we can repeat afterward. Consider what it asks of your actions, and where another teacher may help you see farther. That is part of why I send learners onward when they are ready.
